text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE on pool=infer-west2a (region=us-west2). metric: cuda_alloc_fail_rate > 5% for 3m. Affected services: /v1/generate (some retries), latency up. pagerduty incident: PD-10432

pagerduty-bot: @maria - PagerDuty incident PD-10432 triggered and assigned to you (primary). Use /ack to acknowledge.

maria (oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I'm looking. Any customer reports?

tess (support): I've got a ticket from AcmeCorp saying 500s and "CUDA alloc failed" in logs. Ticket #SUP-8892. Impacting about 4% of their requests.

jon (infra): seeing kvcache evictions spike + fragmentation in GPU pool. sample logs from node gpu-wn-17:

```
E 2023-12-01T14:31:02Z cuda: alloc failed: out of memory, requested 256MB
W 2023-12-01T14:31:02Z kvcache: evicting prefix 0x7ff... current_pages 124/128
I 2023-12-01T14:31:03Z infer: retry attempt=1 trace_id=abc123
```

jon (infra): metrics: free_memory drops in 30s windows, fragmentation ratio > 0.8 on several nodes. Might be a prefetch or malformed kvcache retention.

maria (oncall): ok first mitigation: temporarily remove infer-west2a from routing to avoid customer impact while we investigate. @jon can you trigger route block? Need minimal disruption.

jon (infra): running:
```
# block region for production traffic
kubectl annotate ingress infer-routing region-evac=us-west2 --overwrite
./routingctl set-weight --region us-west2 --service infer --weight 0.0
```

jon (infra): route set, health checks still running but traffic is redirected. Confirming decreased error rate for affected customers.

tess (support): ACME reported errors drop to almost zero after the redirect. They're paused on testing now. Will notify them.

maria (oncall): good. Next: can we free up memory on the pool nodes rather than full node reboot? Suggested quick actions: gracefully drain a few pods, force kvcache purge on the node, and reduce prefetch concurrency.

lee (sre): I'll roll a targeted drain on one suspect host to evict and restart long-lived processes. Command plan:
```
# cordon + drain
gcloud compute instances stop gpu-wn-17 --zone=us-west2-a --maintenance-policy=TERMINATE
# if stop not allowed, fallback to docker restart of infer runtime
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/infer-runtime --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-wn-17
```

lee (sre): also pushing a hotfix to decrease kv-prefetch from 16 -> 8 for the pool: https://git.internal/r/cl/9876

jon (infra): I can force kvcache purge on nodes with:
```
curl -X POST http://gpu-wn-17:8080/admin/kvcache/purge?prefix=
```
But that will increase cold-start latency. Suggest purge only on nodes with fragmentation > 0.7. Running probe to list nodes:
```
python tools/gpu_health.py --metric fragment --threshold 0.7 --output node-list.txt
```

maria (oncall): run the probe and share node list. If safe, purge on top 3 nodes. Keep me posted.

jon (infra): probe finished. nodes: gpu-wn-17,gpu-wn-22,gpu-wn-29. Starting purge on those three now.

incident-bot: action logged: kvcache purge triggered on 3 nodes by jon at 2023-12-01T14:36:40Z.

jon (infra): purge completed. Memory reclaimed ~300MB on each. fragmentation ratio dropped to ~0.45.

maria (oncall): nice. Can we reenable routing gradually? Prefer a canary with 5% back to us-west2 while we monitor.

jon (infra): set weight to 0.05.

pagerduty-bot: PD-10432 acknowledged by maria. escalation disabled while incident is being handled.

maria (oncall): monitoring 10m window. Observability: token-level latency looks stable, cuda_alloc_fail_rate down to 0.4% in region.

tess (support): ACME confirms their synthetic test passed. I'll keep the ticket open and ask for a longer soak test.

lee (sre): follow-up: we should schedule a config roll to reduce default prefetch concurrency and add periodic background defragmentation. Opening RFC: rfc/2023/defrag-kvcache.md and will link to postmortem.

maria (oncall): sounds good. I'm going to close the PagerDuty once we have 30m stable and hand to infra for post-incident cleanup. final checks: any lingering OOM logs?

jon (infra): nothing new after purge & canary. I'll keep watch and collect dmesg + nvml logs for the 3 nodes and upload to the incident folder.

incident-bot: Incident PD-10432 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (traffic reroute + kvcache purge). Will auto-resolve in 30m if no new alerts.

maria (oncall): handing over to lee/jon for postmortem and follow-up actions. I'll add incident notes to the tracker and set severity P2 (customer impact limited, mitigated quickly).

lee (sre): taking ownership of post-incident analysis. I'll create a postmortem doc and schedule a blameless review.

pagerduty-bot: PD-10432 resolved at 2023-12-01T15:05:00Z by maria.

maria (oncall): closing thread here. Thanks team. :heart:
